from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent / "packages/aitm-usage/src"))
from aitm_usage import ledger, monitor_registry

target = Path(sys.argv[1])
try:
    ancestry = ledger._validated_path(target, directory=True)
    directory = monitor_registry._directory(str(target))
except (ledger.LedgerError, PermissionError) as error:
    print(json.dumps({"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}))
    raise SystemExit(4)
expected = tuple((info.st_dev, info.st_ino) for path in (*reversed(target.parents), target)
                 for info in (path.lstat(),))
assert ancestry == expected and directory.path == str(target)
assert directory.identity == expected[-1]
print(json.dumps({"ancestry": len(ancestry), "physical_path": directory.path, "uid": os.geteuid()}))

"""Ordinary-account reproducibility proof for the exact ancestry revision."""
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import subprocess
import sys

lab = Path(sys.argv[1])
hold = Path.cwd()
sys.path[:0] = [str(hold/".github/spikes/368"), str(lab/"admitted")]
import admission
import prior_admission

def check(args, **kwargs):
    result = subprocess.run(tuple(map(str,args)), capture_output=True, text=True, **kwargs)
    return result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr

def digest(path):
    return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

base = "8218a69ad6d9d9f33c6383bd5a6cd4930bef21d7"
binary = lab/"admitted/qualification"
staged = lab/"admitted"
scratch = lab/"worker"
fixture = scratch/"synthetic"
fixture.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=False)
product = staged/"packages/aitm-usage/src/aitm_usage"
tracked = subprocess.check_output(("git","ls-tree","-r","--name-only",base,"packages/aitm-usage/src/aitm_usage")).decode().splitlines()
assert tracked
files = {}
for name in tracked:
    current = staged/name
    expected = subprocess.check_output(("git","show",f"{base}:{name}"))
    assert current.is_file() and current.read_bytes()==expected
    files[name] = digest(current)
assert len(files) == sum(path.is_file() for path in product.rglob("*"))
manifest = sha256(json.dumps(files,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest()
for module in (admission,prior_admission):
    module.ROOT,module.STAGED,module.SCRATCH=lab,staged,scratch
public = (sys.base_prefix,sys.prefix)
exes = (sys.executable,str(Path(sys.executable).resolve()),"/usr/bin/ssh-keygen")
old = prior_admission.boundary_profile(public,exes)
new = admission.boundary_profile(public,exes)
before = f'(allow file-read-metadata (literal "{lab}"))'
after = f'(allow file-read-metadata (literal "/") (literal "/Users") (literal "/Users/Shared") (literal "{lab}"))'
assert old.replace(before,after)==new and before in old
oldfile,newfile=staged/"prior-policy.sb",staged/"revised-policy.sb"
oldfile.write_text(old)
newfile.write_text(new)
environment={"PATH":"/usr/bin:/bin","LC_ALL":"C","HOME":str(scratch),"TMPDIR":str(scratch)}
def sandbox(policy,*args):
    return check(("/usr/bin/sandbox-exec","-f",policy,*args),env=environment,cwd=staged)
owner = str(os.getuid())
canary = lab.with_name(lab.name+".canary")
fd = os.open(canary,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o644)
with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as stream:
    stream.write(b"public synthetic prefix control\n")
    os.fchmod(stream.fileno(),0o644)
try:
    witness=check((binary,"ancestry-readback",lab,scratch,owner))
    assert witness[0]==0 and witness[2]=="",witness
    worker=sandbox(newfile,binary,"ancestry",lab,scratch,owner,Path.home(),canary)
    assert worker[0]==0 and worker[2]=="",worker
    control=[f"DENY LIST {path} EPERM" for path in (lab.parents[1],lab.parent,lab)]
    control.extend(f"DENY {kind} {path} EPERM" for path in (Path.home(),canary) for kind in ("STAT","ACL"))
    control.append(f"DENY DATA {canary} EPERM")
    assert worker[1]==witness[1]+"\n".join(control)+"\n",worker
    trace=(sys.executable,"-I","-B",staged/"worker_path_check.py",fixture)
    denied=sandbox(oldfile,*trace)
    assert denied[0]==4 and json.loads(denied[1])=={"type":"LedgerError","message":"Private ledger ancestry is unavailable"},denied
    allowed=sandbox(newfile,*trace)
    assert allowed[0]==0 and allowed[2]=="",allowed
    assert json.loads(allowed[1])["physical_path"]==str(fixture)
finally:
    canary.unlink()
data={"prior_profile_sha256":digest(oldfile),"revised_profile_sha256":digest(newfile),
      "profile_delta":{"from":before,"to":after},"native_probe_sha256":digest(binary),
      "native_probe_source_sha256":digest(hold/".github/spikes/368/qualification.c"),
      "prior_profile":old,"revised_profile":new,"product_source_commit":base,
      "local_source_manifest":{"sha256":manifest,"entries":len(files),"source_files":files},
      "interpreter":{"version":sys.version,"sha256":digest(Path(sys.executable))},
      "controller_rows":witness[1],"worker_rows":worker[1],
      "prior_product_ancestry":{"exit":denied[0],"record":json.loads(denied[1])},
      "revised_product_ancestry":{"exit":allowed[0],"record":json.loads(allowed[1])},
      "product_test_ids_executed":0}
